script: A city park changes with every season. In spring, cherry trees bloom along the walking paths. Children run across the green grass while their parents sit on wooden benches. In summer, families spread picnic blankets in the shade of tall trees. Ducks swim slowly across the pond. In autumn, the leaves turn orange and red and fall onto the paths. In winter, the park is quiet, covered in a thin layer of frost. Every season, the park gives the city a place to breathe.
